summary: Run 39858275028 of wasm-installed-c.yml was the single dispatch admitted by FS-GG/.github#4710 comment 6351409506, at 056e739 (admission PR #740; reset to None by #741, merged as 6e8ead6 19 min after the run concluded). Artifact 12460831566, digest sha256:37af72d8.... Independent acceptance: FAILED-AS-EVIDENCE, with 0 of 27 cases run. Held hosted: dispatch validation, owner pin and probe, the unit readback (6144 tasks, 12G, 40 min), the recorded WebKit step (51 listed packages installed, no apt or dpkg left, image 20261012.334.1), all 12 pinned acquisitions, and 6 setup groups contained and observed-empty-removed. First cause (deterministic, reproduced locally by owner and critic): managed group setup-006-dotnet, dotnet restore of src/FS.GG.Templates.ProviderTool with --locked-mode and -p:DisableImplicitLibraryPacksFolder=true, failed with NU1403 for FSharp.Core 10.1.401. The ProviderTool lock pins contentHash IGqjL9U8..., which is the author-signed FSharp.Core shipped in SDK 10.0.401's FSharp/library-packs. nuget.org serves the repository-countersigned archive (contentHash /lvOK51K...), and NuGet's contentHash differs once the signature differs. The flag belongs to generated products, whose Directory.Build.props sets it and whose locks pin the nuget.org archive. It was wrongly applied to the repository's own tool. Lessons: fixture executors never run a real restore, so the first hosted execution of prepare_inputs was the first real test. A local NU1403 had been dismissed as host-cache noise by both owner and critic; treat an unexplained NU1403 as a lock or source finding until disproved, and reproduce with the official SDK from clean caches. Remedy, in FS.GG.Templates PR #742: the ProviderTool restore drops the flag (the checker keeps it), and an always-run installed-c-restore-control.yml runs the caller's and checker's exact restore commands from clean caches. A full local rehearsal passed 27/27 before any new admission.
title: First admitted installed-C run failed as evidence: ProviderTool locked restore NU1403 (SDK library-pack FSharp.Core)
